arxiv-1709-03942.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning with Surrogate Agent-Environment Interface
arxiv-1709-03942.creator: Song Wang, Yu Jing
arxiv-1709-03942.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose surrogate agent-environment interface (SAEI) in reinforcement learning. We also state that learning based on probability surrogate agent-environment interface provides optimal policy of task agent-environment interface. We introduce surrogate probability action and develop the probability surrogate action deterministic policy gradient (PSADPG) algorithm based on SAEI. This algorithm enables continuous control of discrete action.

arxiv-1910-09997.creator: Vincenzo Emilio Marotta, Richard J. Szabo
arxiv-1910-09997.description: Abstract . We give a covariant realization of the doubled sigma-model formulation of duality-symmetric string theory within the general framework of para-Hermitian geometry. We define a notion of generalized metric on a para-Hermitian manifold and discuss its relation to Born geometry.

arxiv-2406-18781.creator: Pol Puigdemont, Stratis Skoulakis, Grigorios G Chrysos, Volkan Cevher
arxiv-2406-18781.description: Abstract Cutting plane methods are a fundamental approach for solving integer linear programs (ILPs). In each iteration of such methods, additional linear constraints (cuts) are introduced to the constraint set with the aim of excluding the previous fractional optimal solution while not affecting the optimal integer solution.

arxiv-2408-08197.title: The effect of horizontal shear on extracting water currents from surface wave data
arxiv-2408-08197.creator: Stefan Weichert, Benjamin K. Smeltzer, Simen Å. Ellingsen
arxiv-2408-08197.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Stefan Weichert, Benjamin K. Smeltzer, Simen Å. Ellingsen. The dispersive motion of surface waves is now routinely used to remotely measure the currents close beneath the surface of oceans and other natural flows. The current manifests as wavelength-dependent Doppler shifts in the spatiotemporal wave spectrum, which is obtained by performing a Fourier transform of an observed wave field, a procedure which assumes that the current is horizontally uniform within the field of view. This assumption is frequently not satisfied.

pmc-13243618.title: Dynamic-SQL: an adaptive NL2SQL framework with multi-path fusion reasoning and execution feedback correction
pmc-13243618.creator: Hongbin Hao, Xin Zheng, Xuhong Yu
pmc-13243618.description: Current NL2SQL systems degrade sharply when confronted with practical constraints such as limited prompt length and the inability to fine-tune large language models (LLMs). Performance drop is especially pronounced in complex databases, where inaccurate schema linking, vague value conditions, and weak self-correction dominate the error surface.

pmc-13391319.title: Clinical features and treatment challenges of HER2-positive primary breast squamous cell carcinoma: a case report and literature review
pmc-13391319.creator: Fang Yang, Siyu Guo, Ping Li, Mengqi Yang, Xuan Wu
pmc-13391319.description: Primary breast squamous cell carcinoma (PBSCC) with HER2-positive status is exceptionally rare, with fewer than 100 cases reported globally, and HER2 positivity occurring in only 5.8-7.1% of these cases. No established treatment standards exist for this entity. We present the case of a 43-year-old woman with HER2-positive PBSCC who exhibited a poor response to neoadjuvant TCHP therapy (Miller-Payne grade 2).

pmc-13630353.title: Comparative evaluation of chorion allograft and sub-epithelial connective tissue autograft for the treatment of isolated mandibular recession with laterally closed tunnel (LCT) technique— A pilot study
pmc-13630353.creator: Shalini Mundra, Neetha J. Shetty, R. Vani Lakshmi, Dhruv Ahuja
pmc-13630353.description: Background:Mandibular recession remains challenging because of anatomical limitations, including frenulum attachment, tooth position, and vestibular depth. The laterally closed tunnel (LCT) technique offers a minimally invasive approach for root coverage. This pilot study compared the effectiveness of LCT with chorion membrane (CM) allograft and subepithelial connective tissue graft (CTG) in isolated mandibular Miller’s Class I, II, and III recessions.

uslaw-usc-t18-s1464.title: 18 U.S.C. § 1464 — Broadcasting obscene language
uslaw-usc-t18-s1464.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s1464.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 71 (Obscenity). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Whoever utters any obscene, indecent, or profane language by means of radio communication shall be fined under this title or imprisoned not more than two years, or both.
